exact: Live parts shall comply with paragraphs 5.1.1.1. and 5.1.1.2. for protection against direct contact

For high voltage live parts in areas other than the passenger compartment, or luggage compartment or trailer load compartment, the protection degree IPXXB shall be provided
The symbol shown in Figure 2 shall be present on or near the REESS having high voltage capability. The symbol background shall be yellow
Cables for high voltage buses which are not located within enclosures shall be identified by having an outer covering with the colour orange
The resistance between all exposed conductive parts and the electrical chassis shall be lower than 0.1 ohm when there is current flow of at least 0.2 amperes
If AC high voltage buses and DC high voltage buses are galvanically connected, isolation resistance between the high voltage bus and the electrical chassis shall have a minimum value of 500 Ω/volt
The vehicles shall maintain isolation resistance after exposure to water
